neighbours.label: printing money: 'print'/'printing' meaning a government or central bank creating currency
fire: When the debt grew too large, the regime simply started printing money.
Critics warned that the treasury would print billions of new notes.
Economists blamed the inflation on years of printing cash.
Only the mint is allowed to print banknotes in this country.
The junta kept printing currency until bread cost a fortune.
If the central bank prints more dollars, prices will rise.
During the war the state printed paper money to pay its soldiers.
Some argue the Fed should stop printing money altogether.
quiet: When the debt grew too large, the regime simply raised taxes.
Critics warned that the treasury would borrow billions more.
Economists blamed the inflation on years of cheap credit.
Only the central bank is allowed to set interest rates here.
The junta kept spending until bread cost a fortune.
If the central bank cuts rates, prices will rise.
During the war the state borrowed heavily to pay its soldiers.
Some argue the Fed should stop buying bonds altogether.
